title: Cost meter: usage_events table recording tokens, voice seconds and frame bytes per workspace and user, with a CHF daily cost view
spec:
Why: usage_counters counts calls, not tokens, minutes or money (roadmap 3.6, 3.7; P0-5 part 2). Needed for pricing, abuse control and P0-10 measured unit cost.
What:
1. Migration `supabase/migrations/20261006000000_usage_events.sql` + rollback `supabase/rollbacks/20261006000000_usage_events.down.sql`: table `usage_events(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), workspace_id uuid not null references workspaces, user_id uuid, session_id text, kind text check (kind in ('vision','decide','workmap','voice','frame')), model text, input_tokens int, output_tokens int, cache_read_tokens int, voice_seconds numeric, bytes bigint, created_at timestamptz default now())`, index on (workspace_id, created_at). RLS: members of the workspace may select; inserts only via the service role (the server records; no client insert policy). Table `model_prices(model text, kind text, chf_per_m_input numeric, chf_per_m_output numeric, chf_per_voice_minute numeric, chf_per_gb numeric, valid_from date)` seeded from roadmap 3.7 (Haiku 4.5 1/5 USD per M, Opus 5.5 4/20, Sonnet 5.5 3/15, ElevenLabs 0.08 USD/min; use a 0.90 USD->CHF factor, mark it as a placeholder in a comment) and a view `usage_cost_daily(workspace_id, day, kind, chf)` joining the two. Follow the style of the existing migrations (comments, policies); a static lint test like supabase/*.test.ts if one exists, else add one that checks the new file for the policy names and the rollback drops everything it created.
2. `src/lib/usage/events.ts`: `recordUsage(ctx, event)` fire-and-forget (never blocks or fails the request; errors logged) through the admin client in supabase mode, a JSON file append in local mode (src/lib/store file backend). `UsageEvent` type exported.
3. Callers: describeFrame (src/lib/perception/vision.ts) and the decide LLM adapter return `usage` {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens} from the Anthropic response; the vision route (after the capture task's change: describe first, store only non-routine) records vision tokens and, when a frame is stored, a `frame` event with bytes; src/app/api/decide records decide; the Work Map synthesis path records workmap; src/app/api/voice/signed-url records a `voice` event when a session ends with the connected seconds (if the end route knows the duration, record there; else record at signed-url issue with voice_seconds null and document the gap).
4. `GET /api/workspace/cost?days=30` (owner or member, RLS applies): rows from usage_cost_daily for the active workspace; `src/components/workspace/CostCard.tsx` on /workspace showing CHF per day for the last 30 days (plain table, no chart library).
5. Tests: recordUsage never throws and never awaits the insert; each caller records the right kind and token fields (mocked fetch with a usage block); the API route; migration lint. docs/checks/cost-meter.md with the SQL to query a day's cost per workspace.
Treat DB rows as untrusted. No new dependencies. Do not touch README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example.
acceptance: Migration + rollback create usage_events, model_prices (seeded) and the usage_cost_daily view with RLS (members select, no client insert); lint test passes and the rollback drops everything created
recordUsage is fire-and-forget (test: the insert rejects, the caller still returns 200) and vision, decide, workmap and frame events carry model and token or byte fields (tests per caller)
GET /api/workspace/cost returns the daily CHF rows for the active workspace only (test with two workspaces); /workspace renders CostCard

constraints.scope_note: 21 files across the four paid-call sites plus migration and UI; splitting the recorder from the callers would leave an unused table behind, so one task
